question: Under the amended AI Act, when may providers process special categories of personal data for bias detection?

answer:
Providers of high-risk AI systems may process special categories of personal data only “to the extent strictly necessary to ensure bias detection and correction” and subject to safeguards. Processing is permitted only if other data, including synthetic or anonymised data, cannot effectively achieve the purpose; the data are protected by technical, security and privacy measures, access controls and confidentiality obligations; they are not made accessible to other parties; and they are deleted once the bias is corrected or the retention period ends. The provider must also document why the processing was necessary and why other data would not suffice. [AI Act Art. 4a(1)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:02024R1689-20260727#art_4a)

Providers of other AI systems and models may do so exceptionally only where processing is strictly necessary to detect and correct biases likely to affect health or safety, negatively affect fundamental rights, or lead to discrimination prohibited by Union law—and they must apply all the safeguards and conditions in paragraph 1. Betreiber müssen offenlegen, dass die Deepfake-Inhalte künstlich erzeugt oder manipuliert wurden. Bei offensichtlich künstlerischen, kreativen, satirischen, fiktionalen oder analogen Werken genügt eine geeignete Offenlegung, die Darstellung oder Genuss des Werks nicht beeinträchtigt. [AI Act Art. 50(4)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/DE/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:02024R1689-20260727#art_50) Die Pflicht gilt nicht, wenn die Verwendung gesetzlich zur Aufdeckung, Verhütung, Ermittlung oder Verfolgung von Straftaten zugelassen ist. [AI Act Art. 50(4)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/DE/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:02024R1689-20260727#art_50)
